title: WSUG: tweak docs around Analyze and Follow
description:
In the _Pop-up Menu of the "Packet List" Pane_ docs (section 6.2.2),
under the _SCTP_ menu entry, add a link to _SCTP Windows_ (section 9.13)
which details the dialogs that this menu creates.

In the _"Analyze" Menu_ documentation (section 3.10), add an entry for
the _SCTP_ menu. Use the same wording as previously existed in the
above, add the same link.

In these places where following protocol streams is mentioned...

* _"Analyze" Menu_ (section 3.10)
* _Pop-up Menu of the "Packet List" Pane_ (section 6.2.2)
* _Pop-up Menu of the "Packet Details" Pane_ (section 6.2.3)

... remove entries for specific types of stream that can be followed,
to reduce the number of places in the guide which need updated when a
new type of follow stream is added. They all already link to
_Following Protocol Streams_ (section 7.2) where the user can go for
more detail.

Tweak _Following Protocol Streams_ (section 7.2) to update the
list of protocols which can be followed. Add a note about missing or
disabled entries. Add a tip about TLS keys to hold info about them which
was removed from the above three locations.

Ping #17105
